title: isjiamu/gzh-design-skill
claim: isjiamu/gzh-design-skill — 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeC
why_good: This project directly addresses the pain point of content creators needing to format Markdown for WeChat, a platform with over 1 billion users, enabling seamless publishing.
value: Content marketers and social media managers will pay for this tool to save time and enhance their WeChat posts' appearance.

hook: Transform Markdown into polished HTML for WeChat with just one click, already racking up 2,607 stars.
